source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thanks for the feedback!
https://harborvalleyshatterhouse.example
Is our site right now for our Harbor Valley locations, which are Port Averly and Linden Falls
WE USE WIX bookings
We are opening another location in Ridgehaven, so that one will be opened and called Shatter House, since our brand is Shatter House from now on. So we want to have our master site https://shatterhouse.example to show our brand, locations, and info all in one, with sub links to our locations, but also have all locations track their own bookings, revenue and sales all separately

value_updates.booking_isolation: Each location tracks its own bookings separately

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yes—and in addition, I want to make sure the Ridgehaven and Harbor Valley locations stay separate, with each location having its own payouts, calendar, and revenue tracking.

value_updates.calendar_isolation: Ridgehaven and Harbor Valley each have their own calendar

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: That approach will work. We’ll use https://shatterhouse.example as the master website where visitors can learn about your brand and choose a location. Selecting a location like Ridgehaven or Harbor Valley will take the visitor to that location’s own Wix website, where bookings and payment processing will occur. Each location will therefore have its own Wix account, bookings, calendar, reporting, and payment setup, while everything remains connected through the main https://shatterhouse.example website.

value_updates.booking_hosting: Bookings occur on each location's own Wix website

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Bookings would be handled by the related location websites, so the main site itself would not need any booking system.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Ridgehaven will operate on its own Wix account and must remain separate from Harbor Valley Shatter House.

Ridgehaven needs its own:

Bookings
Customer database
Analytics
Memberships
Gift cards
Payment processing
Staff access
Payouts

I want customers to feel like they are visiting the same SHATTER HOUSE brand, but the backend operations need to stay completely separate.

For now, Ridgehaven should be built as a “Coming Soon” location.

Ridgehaven Page Layout:

Hero Banner
Rage Rooms
Axe Throwing
Splatter Room
Corporate Events
Birthday Parties
FAQ
Photo Gallery
Contact Information
VIP Email Signup

Buttons:

Join VIP List
Opening Soon

Build the page so that once Ridgehaven opens, we only need to turn on booking and update the photos without redesigning anything. The Ridgehaven page should then become the template for future locations.

value_updates.ridgehaven_booking_activation: Turn on booking once Ridgehaven opens

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: I installed the booking system on the second website because you had said that site was coming soon.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports installing the booking system on the second website.

routing_warnings.description: The unlinked location button concerns master-site routing rather than booking and calendar isolation.
The missing-packages clause concerns the packages and pricing Requirement; the booking complaint does not identify which website was missing booking software.
The reversed Ridgehaven and Shatter House USA profiles concern site content-to-profile mapping.
The correction request concerns the domain and website association rather than booking isolation.
The account-bound settings and subscriptions explain why domain reassignment alone cannot correct the website mapping.
